subject: Quick 15m intro — calendar pick?
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir@brightloom.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hitting our token threshold — quick intro to optimize?

Hey Marissa,

We started a small pilot last week and noticed a pretty sharp increase in token usage overnight — looks like several of our engineers are running longer chains. I don’t want this to turn into a surprise bill; can we do a quick 15-minute walkthrough to make sure we’re using the right model variant / batching config?

High level:
- Team: Brightloom ingestion & personalization (3 engineers)
- Spike started ~May 4th, mainly re: longer context windows for batch scoring
- Goal: reduce per-token cost without hurting quality; want pointers on batching, KV cache, and any quick quant settings

I attached a small usage snapshot and our self-serve activity summary so you can see the pattern. Open to a 15-min window this week — mornings PT preferred.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
Director, Data & Personalization
Brightloom

Attachments: usage-snapshot.csv, selfserve-activity-summary.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@brightloom.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hitting our token threshold — quick intro to optimize?

Samir — thanks for the heads-up and the files (looking now). I’m Ben on the SDR team; looping in Marissa who owns post-signup ramp and Soojin from SEs will join to run a quick ops checklist.

I can do a 15-minute slot today at 11:30am PT or tomorrow morning (May 6) between 9–11am PT. If neither works, pick a time and we’ll make it happen. Agenda I suggest:
- 5m: quick context from you
- 7m: concrete config recommendations (batching / cache / model variant)
- 3m: next steps & follow-up items (possible runbook)

I attached our 1-page quickstart guide that covers the common cost levers so you can skim before the call.

—
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf

Thanks for flagging this, Samir — we can definitely help. Ben, thanks for taking point. Soojin, can you join to walk through the runtime knobs?

Samir — three quick windows that work for our team (all PT):
- Wed May 6, 9:00–9:15am PT
- Wed May 6, 10:00–10:15am PT
- Thu May 7, 8:30–8:45am PT

If one fits, reply with your preferred slot and timezone confirmation (I’ll send a calendar invite). If you’d rather use a picker, here’s a quick link to book: https://calendar.redwood.com/book?eid=RDW-3421-15m

Prep note: if you can highlight 1 example prompt/flow that’s generating long context, we’ll prioritize actionable batching/KV tips for that pattern.

—
Marissa Cole

marissa@redwood.com | Redwood Inference

Cheers,
Samir
